nodes.summary: Let $M \ge 2$, let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $\zeta \in R$ be a primitive $M$-th root of unity. The determinant of the principal Fourier minor indexed by the empty subset of $\mathbb{Z}/M\mathbb{Z}$ equals $1$.
nodes.title: Determinant of the empty principal Fourier minor

nodes.summary: Let $M \ge 2$, let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\zeta \in R$ be a primitive $M$-th root of unity, and let $a \in \mathbb{Z}/M\mathbb{Z}$. The determinant of the principal Fourier minor indexed by $\{a\}$ equals $\zeta^{n}$, where $n \in \{0, \dots, M-1\}$ is the representative of $a^2$ in $\mathbb{Z}/M\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Determinant of a singleton principal Fourier minor

nodes.summary: Let $M \ge 2$, let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\zeta \in R$ be a primitive $M$-th root of unity, and let $S$ be a finite subset of $\mathbb{Z}/M\mathbb{Z}$. The principal Fourier minor determinant of $S$ is the determinant in $R$ of the principal Fourier minor indexed by $S$.
nodes.title: Determinant of a principal Fourier minor

nodes.summary: Let $M \ge 2$, let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\zeta \in R$ be a primitive $M$-th root of unity, and let $S$ be a finite subset of $\mathbb{Z}/M\mathbb{Z}$. For all $i, j \in S$, the $(i, j)$ entry of the principal Fourier minor indexed by $S$ equals $\zeta^{n}$, where $n \in \{0, \dots, M-1\}$ is the representative of $ij$ in $\mathbb{Z}/M\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Entries of a principal Fourier minor

nodes.summary: Let $M \ge 2$, let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\zeta \in R$ be a primitive $M$-th root of unity, and let $S$ be a finite subset of $\mathbb{Z}/M\mathbb{Z}$. The principal Fourier minor indexed by $S$ is the $S \times S$ matrix over $R$ whose $(i, j)$ entry is $\zeta^{n}$, where $n \in \{0, \dots, M-1\}$ is the representative of the product $ij$ in $\mathbb{Z}/M\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Principal Fourier minor

nodes.summary: For a natural number $M$ and a commutative ring $R$, root data of order $M$ in $R$ consists of an element $\zeta \in R$ that is a primitive $M$-th root of unity, together with the condition $M \ge 2$.
nodes.title: Primitive root of unity data
